title: Sri Lanka Retreat: Kandy, Bentota and Galle Fort
alt: The lighthouse on the ramparts of the Galle Dutch fort
transport: Private air conditioned car with an English speaking chauffeur guide throughout

stops.name: Kandy
stops.accom: 1 night · Breakfast · Standard room · 3★ · Hilltop hotel with a pool looking down on Kandy

activities.name: Pinnawala Elephant Orphanage
activities.description: A stop on the way up from the airport to watch the resident herd bathe in the Maha Oya river and feed at the sanctuary.

activities.name: Tooth Relic temple, lake and Kandyan dance
activities.description: The Temple of the Sacred Tooth Relic at evening puja, a circuit of the lake and the drummers and dancers of the show.

program.name: Kandy
program.description: One night above Kandy with the elephants on the way, the Tooth Relic temple and the dance show.

stops.name: Bentota
stops.accom: 2 nights · Breakfast · Standard room · 3★ · Beachfront hotel on the Bentota strip

activities.name: Bentota sightseeing, turtle hatchery and fish spa
activities.description: The Kosgoda turtle hatchery, the fish pedicure centre and the Bentota river mouth.

activities.name: Excursion to Galle
activities.description: A day inside the Dutch fort: the ramparts, the lighthouse, the old church and the lanes of cafes and galleries.

program.name: Bentota
program.description: Two nights on the beach with the turtle hatchery and fish spa on arrival and a day inside the Galle fort.

stops.name: Colombo
stops.accom: 1 night · Breakfast · Standard room · 3★ · Modern city hotel in the Colombo Fort district

activities.name: Colombo sightseeing tour
activities.description: Galle Face Green, the Gangaramaya temple, the colonial Fort district, the Lotus Tower and the floating market at Pettah.

program.name: Colombo
program.description: A last night in the Fort district with the sights of the commercial capital.

day_titles.1: Arrival in Colombo and on to Kandy

1: Arrival at Bandaranaike International and private transfer inland
A stop at the Pinnawala elephant sanctuary on the way
The Temple of the Sacred Tooth Relic and a circuit of the lake
The Kandyan dance performance in the evening
2: Breakfast and a transfer from the hills to the coast
The Kosgoda turtle hatchery and the fish pedicure centre
Check in on the Bentota beachfront
The evening at leisure on the sand

expert.name: Aditya
expert.role: Sri Lanka expert at Hi Tours
expert.quote: Bentota is where the trip exhales. After the temples and tea estates, three nights by the water is exactly the right medicine.
expert.tip: Ask for an early start on the Galle day. The fort ramparts are empty before ten and the light on the lighthouse is at its best.

summary: Five days with the fort as the centrepiece: a night in Kandy with the elephants and the Tooth Relic temple, two nights at Bentota with the turtles and a day inside Galle fort, and a last night in Colombo.
included: Included: 4 nights in deluxe class hotels with breakfast daily; private airport transfers and all road travel in an air conditioned car with chauffeur guide; the Pinnawala elephant sanctuary; the Tooth Relic temple, lake drive and Kandyan dance performance; Bentota sightseeing with the turtle hatchery and fish spa; a day excursion to Galle; the Colombo sightseeing tour.
not_included: Not included: international flights; Sri Lanka ETA visa fees; lunches and dinners; entrance tickets; travel insurance; optional excursions; tips and personal expenses.
